title: Rollout pinboard - quick notes and preflight
content:
Context: personal scratchpad for a small-surface canary + version pin run. Use this to capture quick commands, observations and things to double-check before we hand off to oncall. NOT an official runbook; will formalize later if this pattern repeats.

Goals:
- Validate new compilation kernels (v2.3.1) for short-sequence low-latency paths without regressing throughput.
- Pin customer workloads to stable model variant if any anomaly observed.
- Keep end-to-end 99th p95 latency within target (hosted: 120ms p95) while incrementally increasing canary traffic.

High level plan (quick):
1) Smoke on dedicated staging pool (tag: canary-smoke). Run synthetic workload for 15m.
2) Canary: route 1% traffic for 30m -> 5% for 30m -> 20% for 30m -> 50% if stable.
3) Monitor key metrics and rolling alerts at each step, abort on threshold breach.

Preflight checklist (things I want to confirm before starting):
- [ ] Confirm canary pool has new runtime image: serving-runtime:2.3.1-canary-RT.
- [ ] Confirm feature flag for auto-fallback is ON (flag: rollout.auto_fallback).
- [ ] Confirm traffic-steering rule exists and is editable (path: console -> routes -> my-route -> traffic).
- [ ] Ensure we have a pinned config for legacy variant to fallback: model: gptx-13b-legacy@2025-01-10.
- [ ] Notify oncall and CS slack channel with timeframe and rollback plan.
- [ ] Ensure canaryed model has new quantization tag (q4_0) and a compatibility alias.

Quick notes on percentages and timing:
- Start 1% (5 pods) for 30m. If no alerts and p95 <= 120ms and error_rate < 0.2% then ramp.
- 5% for 30m (observe queue depth and GPU utilization). If GPU util > 70% sustained, pause and investigate batching config.
- 20% for 30m (watch end-to-end tails - trace sampling at 10%).
- 50% for 60m then full if stable.

Rollback & pinning commands (handy snippets):
- Quick revert route to pinned variant (curl):
  curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/routes/my-route/traffic" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"traffic":{"canary":0,"stable":100}}'

- Pin an ensemble variant via API:
  curl -X PUT "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/models/gptx-13b/active" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"version":"gptx-13b-legacy@2025-01-10","note":"pin after canary abort"}'

- SRE helper: disable new kernel quickly (k8s label toggle):
  kubectl label nodes -l pool=canary runtime-enabled=false --overwrite

Key metrics to watch (alerts to pay attention to):
- Latency p50/p95/p99 (api gateway and model server).
- Error rate (5xx) and model inference errors (kv cache misses causing errors).
- GPU utilization and host-level OOM/kernel restarts.
- Token cost per request bump (unexpected increases = degenerate loops).
- Trace sampling for function calls that show long tail (> 2s).

Quick troubleshooting notes (things I've run into in prior attempts):
- Symptom: p95 spikes but GPU utilization low -> often batching misconfig (batch scheduler fallback to synchronous path). Check batcher logs: /var/log/batcher.log and rpc latency histograms.
- Symptom: SSE stream closes early -> check edge proxy keepalive (env EDGE_KEEPALIVE) and nginx upstream timeouts.
- Symptom: subtle accuracy change -> run small eval set before wide ramp (eval set: regressions/short-prompts-200.json).

Open questions / TODOs:
- Can we add a short-circuit that does 3x faster fallback if any single customer sees >2% error rate? (todo: propose flag rollout.fast_abort_per_customer).
- Who owns the customer pinning flow for enterprise customers? Add owner to formal runbook.
- Collect recent canary run artifacts and attach to GH PR for visibility.

Post-run: what to collect and attach to PR/incident:
- 30min aggregated metrics snapshot at each step (1%,5%,20%,50%).
- Two traces for any 5xx during the run.
- A/B prompt quality check on sample set (5 prompts) comparing legacy vs canary.
- Notes on any manual interventions and timestamps.

Quick timeline for today:
- 10:00 - preflight checks + push canary image (me).
- 10:30 - staging smoke run (Kenji).
- 11:15 - start 1% canary (notify #oncall).
- 12:45 - 5% if green (Aisha watching metrics).

Personal reminders (notes to self):
- Keep Slack message short: include exact rollback curl and expected metrics.
- If something looks off, pause ramp; do not proceed on hopes.
- Capture everything in the JIRA ticket REL-452 with timestamps for post-mortem.

End-of-doc: save quick diffs of route config before/after: console -> export JSON -> attach to ticket.

(End of scratchpad)
